==Description==
'''Broomstick''' is an emote obtained from the [[Hexscape Event#Hexscape Event Battle Pass|Hexscape Event Battle Pass]]. It was made by Vylith and Capra_K. The emote is looped and no music can be heard while performing the emote. Players can move while performing this emote. This emote cannot be interacted with. This emote makes the player fly on a broomstick.

This emote could be obtained at Level 38 of the regular track, where it costed {{CandyCorns|1,360 Candy Corns}} or {{Robux|206}} ({{Robux|154}} for the Black Friday 2024 Sale) to unlock. It had a total cost of {{CandyCorns|24,220 Candy Corns}} or {{Robux|3,422}} ({{Robux|2,567}} for the Black Friday 2024 Sale).

==Trivia==
*The inventory description is a reference to the ''Harry Potter'' series, as it is a layman translation of the quote said by Rubeus Hagrid in the ''Philosopher's Stone'' to Harry Potter.
